n596cee7055.headline: Vítka's real estate group CPI buys company that operates hotels for it | Aktuálně.cz
n596cee7055.summary: CPI Property Group is buying CPI Hotels, which operates hotels owned by CPI Property Group, consolidating its hotel operations.
n596cee7055.why: This acquisition strengthens CPI Property Group's control over its hotel assets, potentially improving operational efficiency and profitability.
